== Strategy ==

This deck works well.  It basically is my Walkers In The City deck, modified to reflect some suggestions, test experience and card haves.  Pulling sites has never been a problem, and I’ve always had all three sites in play or in hand within 3 turns.

Round 1-

Lost to HB Asteroids.  Lost mostly due to drain cancellation and beatdown on Executor.

Round 2-

Beat Agents In The Court.  Flipped early and caused big drains.  Differential would have been higher, except I forgot to drain/damage one turn.  Had 2 good beatdowns, including a cantina takeover.

Round 3-

Beat Dantooine Ops.  Flipped in 4 turns.  Easily defeated a desperate Bespin takeover, which started with 5 ships, and was down to 3 at the beginning of battle thanks to Tallon Roll.  Beatdown 2 Dresselian Commandoes and an Incom Engineer with Blizzard 4, Kidik (V) and Vader w/ stick.
